content: अनुष्टुभ् €1 <ab>P.</ab> (˚स्तुभ्) To praise after, follow in praising.

अनुष्टुभ् {%f.%} [अनु निरन्तरम् स्तुभ्यतेऽनया अनुष्टुप् वाक्] .²1 Following in praise; speech. .²2 Sarasvatī. .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of a class of metres consisting of four Pādas of 8 syllables each, the whole stanza consisting of 32 syllables (so called because it follows with its praise {%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} अनुष्टोभति the Gāyatrī, which has 3 Pādas), अनुष्टोभनादनुष्टुप्. In later metrical systems it stands as a general name for all metres which have 8 syllables in each foot (the highest possible number being computed to be 256); पञ्चमं लघु सर्वत्र सप्तमं द्विचतुर्थयोः . गुरु षष्ठं च पादानां शेषेष्वनियमो मतः .. which rule is sometimes violated. अनुष्टुभा सोम उक्थैर्महस्वान् <ls>Rv. 10. 130. 4</ls>.
